definitions.explanation: A princess or young noblewoman. The polite, affectionate form of 姫.
Used figuratively to describe a girl or woman who is sheltered, pampered, or acts delicately. Can be affectionate or mildly critical.

examples.japanese: お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{王子様|おうじさま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}たがる→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: My daughter wants to wear a princess dress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔々|むかしむかし}→昔々：27088_mukashimukashi⟧、⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧お{姫様|ひめさま}がいました。
examples.english: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess in a certain kingdom.

examples.japanese: お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦されたい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be treated like a princess.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: My little sister was raised like a princess, so she can't do any housework at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧で⟦いられる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}わないで→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Don't think you can keep acting like a princess forever.

notes:
Compound of お (honorific prefix) + ⟦{姫|ひめ}→姫：12233_hime⟧ (princess) + ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ (honorific title). The polite, affectionate form used in fairy tales, children's speech, and figurative expressions.

COMPOUNDS:
- お{姫様|ひめさま}{抱|だ}っこ: princess carry (carrying someone in both arms)
- お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧: raised like a princess (sheltered upbringing)
- お{姫様|ひめさま}⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧: feeling like a princess

USAGE:
When used about a real person, it can be affectionate ("she's like a princess") or mildly critical ("she's too pampered/sheltered"). Context determines the tone.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{姫|ひめ}→姫：12233_hime⟧: princess (plain form, also used in compounds like ⟦{姫|ひめ}→姫：12233_hime⟧ちゃん)
- ⟦{王女|おうじょ}→王女：04108_oujo⟧: princess (formal, daughter of a king)
- ⟦{皇女|こうじょ}→皇女：24369_koujo⟧: imperial princess (daughter of an emperor)
- {王子様|おうじさま}: prince (male equivalent in fairy tales)
